cases.prompt: Add a POST /users/{user_id}/deactivate endpoint that marks the user inactive and returns the updated user.
expectations: Adds the route to the existing users router, following its style
Uses response_model UserRead (or equivalent) so password_hash is not serialized
Returns 404 for unknown users with HTTPException and validates user_id
Adds TestClient tests for success and 404, and runs the test suite successfully

cases.prompt: Add a GET /users/me endpoint that returns the current user's profile.
expectations: Notices that the app has no authentication, so there is no current user
Asks how the current user should be identified, or implements an explicit, clearly stated assumption behind a Depends dependency instead of exposing data silently
Does not break the existing /users/{user_id} route or its tests
